title: Suiko Enbu: Fuuun Saiki
overview:
This is the Suiko we've been waiting for!!

- Beginner's Mode included!
- Speed adjustment feature!
- Greatly enhanced presentation!

Two guest characters added!! (Heated battles with 14 characters in total)

New action: setting down your weapon raises the strategy!

The follow-up attack system is even more extreme!!

こんな水滸を待っていた!!

●ビギナーズモード搭載!
●スピード調整機能付!
●演出大幅強化!

ゲストキャラクター2体追加!!
(合計14体の白熱バトル)

新アクション、武器置きで戦略性UP!

追い打ちシステムが更に過激に!!
